from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json
p=Path("results/backup_gdrive_host_20261011/r11_package_20261011T005440Z")

state=json.loads((p/"mb42_hostfix1_stop_state.json").read_text())
expected=dict(state["protected_unchanged"])
expected.update({x["path"]:x["current_sha256"] for x in state["changed"]})
expected.update(json.loads((p/"mb42_hostfix1_diskutil_inputs.json").read_text()))
for path,value in expected.items(): assert digest(Path(path))==value,(path,"STOP drift")
pins=json.loads((p/"pins_v2.json").read_text())

assert set(stale)=={x["path"] for x in state["changed"] if not x["path"].endswith("test_hostfix_mb42.py")},stale

with (p/"mb43_entry_snapshot.json").open("x") as f: json.dump(dict(hashes=snapshot,protected=state["protected_unchanged"],diskutil_inputs=json.loads((p/"mb42_hostfix1_diskutil_inputs.json").read_text())),f,indent=2); f.write("\n")
for name in ("README.md","activation_plan_v2.md","host_commands.sh","host_commands.md","pins_v2.sha256","pins_v2.json","bulk_not_in_git_sha256.json"):
    src=p/name
    with (p/"before"/("mb43_"+name)).open("xb") as f: f.write(src.read_bytes())
print(json.dumps(dict(result="PASS",protected_count=len(state["protected_unchanged"]),corrected_sources=4,diskutil_inputs=5,receipt_snapshot_count=len(snapshot),expected_stale_pins=stale,before_copies=7)))
